about: Producer's routing table (foundry-build-0048 U7): every clossys.queue-entry/2 is routed by these rows, in order; the first row whose kinds and match hold wins. Matches are closed names the router computes from data (queue/routing.ts): live (the target slot is placed), owner-class (the target is in a class an owner step of a loop version reserves, read from its `when`), home (the target agent holds a placed slot with the need's first id segment), agent (the target names a content agent), decider (a decision kind keeps its own decider), any. A handler row routes only the kind it handles, to the loop that answers that kind (queue/routing.ts loopAnswers: loop.slot answers a slot entry, a slot loop a change or fix). Owner classes are never listed here. The last row is the only catch-all.
